record.label: SUB-5: package, panel LOO beta, virgin gate, fire
record.summary: Recurse out: card + whichever of SUB-1/SUB-2 wins; 8-net panel LOO for beta_v (frozen 0.40 sign-stable on 35/100/150); virgin gate; co-fire with the held f32 pack (-4.9% adj); fire only at the meaningful bar (>=8-10% adj). Recomposes N4/N5 with the winner.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when a card with the retrofitted/parallel correction is graded on the board.
record.goal_path_summary: Turn the winning correction into a submission: check it on all eight test networks with weights fixed in advance, pass the unseen-network gate, and submit together with the already-verified compute saving.
